latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add AI-generated voiceovers to your videos quickly and easily.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 videos with AI voiceover.
- Seamless setup: automatic cloud connection, 100 free credits for new users, fast session handling.
- Intuitive prompt handling for uploading videos, exporting, checking credits, and editing tracks.
- Real-time cloud processing; typical turnaround 30–60 seconds per video.
- Robust error handling with clear user feedback on file size, credits, and export limits.
- Designed for content creators and marketers to voiceover silent videos without local installs.
